corridor_notes: Per the Chongqing Development and Reform Commission's 2021-11-11 project approval notice (published 2023-02-13, fzggw.cq.gov.cn), this is a short newly-built DN323.9mm tie-in spur connecting the existing Tongxiangxian valve chamber (铜相线阀室) to the Yinxiang gas distribution station operated by Chongqing Zhengneng Gas Co., Ltd. (重庆正能燃气有限责任公司), both located in Tuchang Town (土场镇), Hechuan District, Chongqing. Design pressure 10 MPa, designed capacity 3.5 million m3/day, investment ~10 million yuan.
researcher_notes: SPECIAL NOTE RESOLVED: GEM's LengthMergedKm of 0.13 km is NOT a data defect -- the official approval notice states the new pipeline is approximately 130 meters long (0.13 km exactly), a very short tie-in connector from the existing Tongxiangxian valve chamber to the Yinxiang distribution station, both within Tuchang Town. No length correction needed.
